pipeline: full real pipeline: 25 Map grids, causal signals, independent one-slot books, frozen exit/cost/gap fills, deterministic matched random control, family/strategy verification and sensitivity sweep

generator.clock: M30 EAT 01:00-23:30 Monday-Friday, sessions assigned by the frozen EAT clock; weekends skipped; three isolated segments with non-DEV holes between them

conditionC.generatorSize: after each eligible Donchian20 signal, add a signed return of 0.45 × 1.5 ATR / 10 to each of the next 10 bars; this targets about +0.30R net after frozen costs; overlapping impulses are clipped at one impulse per bar.

plantedEdge.generatorSize: per-bar added return = 0.45 × frozen stop multiple (1.5 ATR) × signal-bar ATR / 10 bars; signed by Donchian signal direction. This targets about +0.30R net after the frozen synthetic cost scale. Overlapping impulses are clipped to ±one signal's per-bar contribution, not summed.
